records.name: Action Economy Bands
records.replaces: The 2014 DMG multiple-monster XP multipliers, which are not in the SRD and are not reproduced here.
records.preferredOpenMethod: Use extras/encounterDifficultyA5e.json: sum monster CRs, double elite CRs, and bump fractional CRs for levels 1-4. No multiplier is required.

optionalOriginalRule.description: If you are using SRD 5.2 per-character XP budgets (5.2/encounterBudgets.json) instead of A5E CR ratios, adjust the listed difficulty band after spending the budget:

rows.condition: Monsters outnumber the party 2-to-1 or more
rows.effect: Treat the encounter as one band harder (low becomes moderate, moderate becomes high, high becomes higher than the budget allows).

rows.condition: The party outnumbers the monsters 2-to-1 or more
rows.effect: Treat the encounter as one band easier.
No change, but prefer a legendary or elite opponent (or add minions) if you want a hard fight for four or more characters.
